message.content: {"draft":"Use 1D grid with 128x128 tiles and vectorized loads/stores to fix large-shape latency.","plan":"Launch one program per 128x128 tile. Load tile, transpose in registers, store. Masks handle odd sizes. 1D grid reduces launch overhead.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","@triton.jit","def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N,","                     BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    num_n_blocks = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)","    pid_m = pid // num_n_blocks","    pid_n = pid % num_n_blocks","    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)","    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)","    mask_m = offs_m < M","    mask_n = offs_n < N","    mask = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]","    x_ptrs = x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * N + offs_n[None, :]","    x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=mask, other=0.0)","    out_ptrs = out_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :]","    tl.store(out_ptrs, x.T, mask=mask.T)","    ","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    M, N = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((N, M), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    BLOCK_M = 128","    BLOCK_N = 128","    grid = (triton.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M) * triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N),)","    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK_M=BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N)","    return out"]}
